opportunities.title: AI-Powered B2B SaaS: Automated Contract Intelligence
opportunities.description: LLM-driven contract review, risk flagging, and clause extraction for SMBs and law firms. Replace $500/hr lawyers for routine contract work.
opportunities.debate_summary: Strong consensus. Legal AI is a $50B+ TAM. Competitors exist (Harvey, Klarity) but SMB gap is underserved. MVP buildable in 6-8 weeks.

opportunities.title: Micro-SaaS: AI LinkedIn Ghostwriting & Lead Gen Automation
opportunities.description: Automated LinkedIn content engine that generates posts, engages comments, and qualifies inbound leads for B2B founders and executives.
opportunities.debate_summary: Fast validation path. $49-199/mo subscription. Dissent from SENTINEL: platform dependency risk on LinkedIn API. LEDGER notes low CAC potential via cold outbound irony.

opportunities.title: AI Agent Marketplace: No-Code Business Automation Store
opportunities.description: A marketplace where businesses buy pre-built AI agent workflows (hiring, invoicing, customer support, reporting). Subscription + revenue share model.
opportunities.debate_summary: Highest long-term ceiling. Platform moat is defensible. VECTOR flags: slower time-to-validation (3-4 months). LEDGER: requires $15-30K initial build. SENTINEL: marketplace cold-start risk is manageable with seed sellers.
